label: memory-core parentDocId fallback fix — round 2 re-review

findings.description: Bug 1 (Wrong SQL) — CONFIRMED FIXED. The fallback query now reads `WHERE uid = ?` instead of the incorrect `WHERE session_id = ? AND rowid != ?`. The parameter is correctly supplied as `currentNode.session_id`, which holds the parent's UID. This correctly fetches the parent node, not siblings.

Bug 2 (Missing source addition) — CONFIRMED FIXED. The parent row is now pushed to `sources[]` at line 612-615 (`sources.push({chunk: {uid: parentRow.uid, content: parentRow.content, name: parentRow.name}, depth})`) before the `continue` at line 619. The token budget (`expandedTokens`) is also correctly incremented at line 616 before continuing the loop.

The parentDocId fallback path (lines 587-622, exercised when `stmtParentEdge.get()` returns undefined) has no dedicated test coverage. Existing parent-child recall tests in write.spec.ts create DERIVED_FROM edges, so they exercise the primary edge-based path, not the fallback. The fallback is a degradation path for when the graph edge is missing but `session_id` still references the parent UID.
findings.fix_sketch: Add a test in recall.spec.ts (or a new recall.expand.spec.ts) that: (1) inserts a parent node and a child node with `session_id` set to the parent's UID but WITHOUT a DERIVED_FROM edge in the graph; (2) calls `recall()` with expand-context enabled; (3) asserts the parent appears in the expanded sources array.
